Team,

Attached is my first pass at the outreach sequence for the May 12 "Precision Inference: Cost-aware Serving" webinar — file: outreach_sequence_v1.xlsx. Key pieces I tried to capture: 

- Target lists: engineering (dev+infra), platform leads, mid-market product teams. We should seed with: attendees from last year's infra webinar + active trial customers (filter: last 90d API usage > 10k tokens).
- RSVP cadence: initial invite, 7-day reminder, 3-day reminder, 24-hour final reminder, and a day-of live push for registrants who haven't joined.
- Sponsor link stitching: each sponsor gets a unique RSVP link (utm_sponsor + sponsor_id). We need server-side fallback so if a sponsor pixel fails, we still credit them via a hashed link param.
- Subject line test: A/B test 3 variants focused on cost, latency, and reliability.
- Exclusion logic: if prospects received a partner outreach in last 14 days exclude from initial send.

Asks: 
1) Marissa — can you add the VIP quick-invite list (45 people) to sheet tab "VIP" and flag anyone who should get a 1:1 follow-up from solutions?
2) Ben — please review link stitching approach and add tracking-level params to the sponsor_link_map.csv format so we can map click->register->attend attribution.
3) Laura — is the standard compliance blurb for sponsor logos correct for our email footer?

I referenced HubSpot campaign 678912 and a placeholder Drive folder in the sheet. Looking to lock the cadence by Friday EOD so ops can schedule.

Thanks,
Dylan
